CI on patch set 1 of Gerrit 1942: 1 failed, 14508 passed. The single failure is tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py::test_copy_repoints_sibling_origin_and_keeps_refs_isolated — a shutil.copytree race against git auto-maintenance's objects/maintenance.lock, with no path to the config-reference generator this change touches.

Per scope discipline it was NOT absorbed into this change. Filed as bug regardable-superduper-whiteeye (dca1-f641-caeb-4df4), linked discovered_from this ticket, with the mechanism, the deterministic reproduction, and a remove-the-race fix specified. Same root-cause class as the already-closed chewed-illicit-blacklemur / icicled-unstable-urial. A reasoned 'recheck' citing that ticket was posted on 1942.

Local validation of the blast radius (all green): tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py, test_gen_env_registry.py, test_generated_surface_markers.py, test_env_registry_helper_coverage.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_gerrit_docs_only.py, test_llm_config_pointer.py, and tests/scripts — 1133 passed, 2 skipped.
